title: AI-Assisted Classification under Correlation Neglect and Trust
abstract: arXiv:2611.05870v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When does an AI assistant improve human decision-making, and when does it hurt? We argue that the answer depends not just on AI accuracy but also on how much its evidence overlaps with the human's and how the human combines the two. A worker makes a binary decision by observing her own signal and receiving a recommendation from an AI. We develop a human behavioral model with two primitives: her awareness of the overlap and her trust in the AI. Our analysis gives a closed-form phase diagram over AI capability and overlap, with regions of complementarity, impairment, and automation. A worker who neglects the overlap (correlation neglect) can be made less accurate by a more capable AI, double-counting the shared evidence. Trust reshapes the regions - undertrust may compensate for correlation neglect, so that the trust level maximizing accuracy depends on the deployment parameters. translated_title: 相关性忽视与信任下的人工智能辅助分类
translated_abstract: AI助手何时能改善人类决策，何时又会有所损害？我们认为，答案不仅取决于AI的准确性，还取决于其证据与人类证据的重叠程度，以及人类如何将两者结合起来。决策者通过观察自身信号并接收AI的推荐来做出二元决策。我们构建了一个包含两个基本要素的人类行为模型：她对证据重叠的认知程度以及她对AI的信任程度。我们的分析给出了关于AI能力与证据重叠程度的闭式相图，其中划分出互补、损害与自动化三个区域。忽视证据重叠（即相关性忽视）的决策者，可能因为能力更强的AI反而降低决策准确性，原因是她重复计算了共享的证据。信任会重塑这些区域——信任不足可能补偿相关性忽视，因此使准确性最大化的信任水平取决于具体的部署参数。在实证部分，我们通过配对……识别这两个模型参数。
tldr: 该论文提出包含相关性忽视与AI信任两个要素的人类决策行为模型，通过闭式相图划分AI辅助决策的互补、损害与自动化区域，并证明更强的AI可能因人类重复计算重叠证据而降低其决策准确性，而适当低水平的信任反而可以补偿相关性忽视。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a behavioral model of AI-assisted binary decision-making with correlation neglect and trust, showing through closed-form phase diagrams that more capable AI can reduce human accuracy via double-counting overlapping evidence, while undertrust may compensate for this bias across regions of complementarity, impairment, and automation.
